comment: Partial review, narrow scope. Lone species-C particle, start (2,5), velocity (1,0), 12 time units, one x=10 wall hit at t=8 (tracker dt 0.05). Residual against the P-0002 model.py reflected-line predictor: rms 0.052 (x) and 0.049 (y), mean residual below 0.004, max |res| 0.15, 0 census events. This matches the claim at speed 1.0 and duration 12. I have NOT yet tested what the claim is written for: speed 3.6, duration 40, many bounces, drift over long runs. Edge tests are queued as review requests 2026-11-18/r1/lab-a/014 (speed about 8.6, 40 time units), 015 (exact corner hit from (8,8) with velocity (3,3)), and 016 (speed 0.22 over 100 time units, drift check). I will update this review when those results arrive. The verdict covers only the tested scope.
